claims: Mark Lee is officially leaving NCT and SM Entertainment.
SM Entertainment released official statements on April 3, 2026.
Mark Lee's exclusive contract concludes on April 8, 2026.
Mark Lee's departure ends his ten-year tenure with NCT, including NCT 127 and NCT DREAM.
Mark Lee confirmed his departure with an emotional message shared on Instagram.
Billboard reported that Mark Lee is departing to focus on a new path.
NCT 127 will continue as a seven-member group.
NCT DREAM will continue as a six-member group.
SM Entertainment confirmed Mark Lee's departure via a note shared by WWD and other outlets.
Reddit users reported that Mark Lee would be leaving the team after his 10-year anniversary
